high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a WhatsApp message containing an article or excerpt about the impact of automation on different types of jobs. The text discusses how manual labor roles, such as plumbing, carpentry, and electrical work, are more resistant to automation compared to office roles that involve data handling or repetitive intellectual tasks. It mentions that artificial intelligence (AI) struggles with physical judgment in unpredictable environments, which makes these manual labor roles relatively safe for now.
